offering_description.value: Designs and sells enterprise data storage hardware, data management software and cloud data services. Customers are enterprises, cloud providers and public agencies, served through direct sales, partners and cloud marketplaces, and the company builds its hardware with contract manufacturers.

primary_products.value: storage arrays; data management software; cloud storage services; hybrid cloud infrastructure systems

primary_services.value: technical support; professional services; data migration services

customer_segment.value: B2B: enterprises, cloud and managed service providers, telecom operators, technology companies; B2G: government agencies and defense organizations

end_markets.value: enterprise IT; cloud services; financial services; healthcare; government

revenue_model.value: product sales: storage hardware systems sold to enterprises and service providers; subscription: software and cloud data services billed on subscription or consumption terms; service fees: support contracts and professional services for installed systems

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds storage systems from purchased components, sold to enterprises and resellers; software / platform: data management operating software licensed across on-premises and cloud deployments; service provider: cloud data services and support delivered to business customers
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; software / platform; service provider

geography_served.value: global: Sells and supports customers across North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and other regions worldwide.

specialization.value: related lines: storage hardware, data management software, cloud data services and support

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to large enterprise and government accounts; partners / resellers: channel partners, systems integrators and cloud resellers; distributors / dealers: distributors supplying regional resellers; online: cloud marketplaces offering the company's services to customers
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; partners / resellers; distributors / dealers; online

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: data privacy and security rules and export controls on advanced technology apply to its products and services

notes: Company size and some channel and revenue details are judgments from its public description.
